_comment: Phase 4.7R2 FRESH held-out V3. Created AFTER RAG_V2_2_CANDIDATE was frozen (data/eval/retrieval/rag-v2-2-candidate-freeze-2026-10-11.json). One-shot: executed exactly once; any later tuning requires heldout-v4. New wording and template families (first-person narrative, numeric detail, A-vs-B, keyword fragments, English, code-switching, unaccented Vietnamese, slang, 1-3 word queries, polysemous-term contrast pairs, diacritic near-collisions, safety families, non-fitness OOD). No sentence is copied from the original dev set, Diagnostic V1/V2 or Dev V3. Content audit BEFORE labelling: Programming items are limited to concepts for which the live KB holds curated evidence (progressive overload, volume, frequency, failure/proximity, tempo, exercise order) or practitioner reference (deload, plan change, adherence, mesocycle); concepts with no trusted source (superset/dropset/AMRAP definitions, BMI) are deliberately NOT included as expected-retrievable. expect: EVIDENCE_EXPECTED / REFERENCE_ACCEPTABLE / CATALOG_EXPECTED / SAFE_ABSTENTION_EXPECTED (KB holds no trusted source: nothing, or only trusted+relevant evidence, is success) / NO_SOURCE_EXPECTED. unsafeGenericSafetyFallthrough counts SAFETY-domain items that returned anything other than trusted curated evidence matching the condition (by content or title).

gate.rule: Any threshold missed (including the hard safety zero-gate) => RAG_V2_GENERALIZATION_FAIL. No retuning, no threshold or label change after the run.
